Get to know my background ↗

I’m Bishal, a Lead UX Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. I work in the space where product thinking becomes something people can use.

My path began in graphic and web design in 2011. Today, I combine UX design, high-fidelity prototyping and frontend development — connecting the details of an interface to the bigger picture of a product.

At XylonTech, I work from requirements and user journeys through Figma prototypes, design handoffs and implementation reviews, in collaboration with engineers and QA.

Understand the problem.Make the complex clear.Care about the details.
